questions.objective: Assess bowel pattern, frequency, and stool consistency
questions.patient_text: How would you describe your bowel movements most days? (Koshta)

options.label: Soft or loose stools, 2 to 3 times a day easily
Formed, regular stool once or twice daily without straining
Hard, dry stools, tend to be constipated or strain frequently

questions.objective: Assess bowel responsiveness to mild food triggers (e.g. warm milk)
questions.patient_text: How easily does warm milk, fruits, or mild warm water induce bowel movement? (Koshta)

options.label: Very easily — mild warm milk or fruit immediately causes bowel movement
Normally — regular daily stimulus works fine
Requires strong effort or strong laxatives to get relief
